description:
Juice Hunter, Chil-Yong, and Koz have teamed up to bring our readers a series of unique omegaverse stories featuring a variety of leading male couples. Our couples include a dominant alpha/omega, a dominant omega/alpha, and a recessive alpha/dominant omega. Kicking off the series is “Mockingbird:” a story where our lead omega, Kei, has a gambling addiction that’s left him with nothing but debt. And just when he thought he couldn’t fall any deeper, Mei steps in and offers him a solution. 

(Source: Lezhin) 

**Release includes:**
1-11. **Mockingbird** (모킹버드) by Koz
12-22. **Simyageunmu** (심야근무; Midnight Job) by Juicy Hunter
23-46. **Haeilcheoreom Millyeowa** (해일처럼 밀려와; Like a Tidal Wave) by Chil-Yong

*Notes:
\- Last story includes 2 Christmas extra chapters.
\- All stories contain a prologue.*
